THE FATIMIYAH INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY (FIU) AT KARACHI ACT, 2026
Sindh Act No. XXXVI of 2026

1. Short title.- This Act may be called the Fatimiyah International University (FIU) at Karachi Act, 2026 and it extends to the Province of Sindh.
2. Definitions.- In this Act the words in this section have the meanings assigned for the Province of Sindh.
3. Establishment.- There shall be established a university at Karachi in accordance with this Act and it shall come into force at once.
